About me

Hi, Zin here! I feel good marketing moves people through the whole funnel, from first hearing about a brand to buying, coming back and bringing friends. Over eight years in e-commerce and fintech, across Southeast Asia and global markets, I've worked on every side of that: campaigns, partnerships, events, PR, CRM and loyalty.

My best work happens between teams: data, creative, product, tech, compliance and agencies. The approach is simple: shape the plan from the data, get hands-on with execution, and measure what worked so the next campaign is better.

Kuala Lumpur is home, and as a Malaysian permanent resident, no visa sponsorship is needed for me to work in Malaysia. Alongside full-time roles, I also consult independently, helping clients with marketing strategy, go-to-market and campaign execution.

Selected work

Campaigns and programmes I've planned and run end to end, across four companies and two industries.

ZALORA, 2019–2022

11.11 and Black Friday mega campaigns

At ZALORA, I worked alongside the marketing, category and brand teams on our biggest sale seasons across the region, from 11.11 and Black Friday to the mid-year Big Fashion Sale. My focus was partnerships: bringing mega partners on board for each campaign season and driving our partnership sales targets through them.

Between the peaks, I managed an evergreen channel of 80+ partners in Malaysia that kept external traffic, sign-ups and sales coming in all year.

Payment partnerships and co-marketing

I ran co-marketing with some of the region's biggest payment, bank and retail partners, from co-branded festive pushes and cashback offers to spend-lift campaigns and on-ground activations like ShopBack's ShopFiesta with Sunway Pyramid. Blueberry Markets, 2023–2025

CRM and lifecycle marketing for a fintech trading brand

At Blueberry, I owned CRM end to end for a global audience. I led the migration from Braze to Iterable with zero downtime, owning the data migration, integrations and a full rebuild of our lifecycle, then designed automated, trigger-based journeys that take people from sign-up to their first trade and keep them trading.

Every send was segmented and personalised, and tested with A/B tests and control groups so we could prove what moved conversion. Journeys were layered with referral drives, seasonal promotions and product launches, and all messaging was reviewed with Compliance, Legal and Risk.

+30%month-on-month conversion growth, with zero downtime during the platform migration

Blueberry Markets

VIP loyalty programme, built from zero

I launched a VIP membership programme called the Blueberry VIP Trading Room: a members-only online community. As the project lead, I integrated and launched it on a white-label platform, with tiered access, expert market analysis and rewards channels. I coordinated external reward partners and internal teams to turn early adopters into active, high-value members.

ShopBack: ShopFiesta with Sunway Pyramid, a mall activation picked up by the press, plus our International Women's Day and Raya campaigns.
